text.text: The Spear is a charging weapon: hold right-click to lower it, then trade speed for damage.

Charge damage is 1 + multiplier x the relative speed (blocks per second) between you and the target. The target only takes damage above 4.6 b/s, and it is only knocked back when your own speed is above 5.1 b/s; in the engaged stage a fast enough joust dismounts the rider.

properties: Charge damage scales with relative speed
